reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the click-brief-hum-silence pattern as a compressor start relay/overload fault with the compressor itself as the unresolvable alternative, sensibly had the homeowner clean the condenser with the unit unplugged while warning not to disturb compressor electrics, and escalated to an engineer to test the start device before condemning the compressor, with honest guidance on the £150 budget. Conversation 2 repeated the same boilerplate safety and 'clean the back' script verbatim, re-asked a question the customer had already answered twice, never confirmed the click source or pattern, and only reached the start device/compressor diagnosis in its last turn without any escalation advice. Both stayed within the safety boundary, but Conversation 1 was efficient, diagnostic and actionable where Conversation 2 was repetitive and largely unresponsive.
